snippet.title: Tretrais - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Tretrais - Gameplay Trailer 🌌
Welcome to Tretrais, a game that blends survival, exploration, and strategy! After a mysterious crash on Mars, you must build shelters from wreckage, set up defense systems, and fight off waves of enemies that arrive every night.

🛠️ Build your own machines, upgrade your weapons, and protect yourself with automated defense systems. Every moment is a challenge, every night a test of survival.

🎮 Tretrais will be playable during Steam Next Fest, June 9–16!
Download the demo and be among the first to experience the game!

🌐 Follow us for more updates and don’t forget to add Tretrais to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3368400
